items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 11:42am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind warning.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of Ireland. High over northern France, transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, then increasing more generally 5 or 6 for a time late afternoon and this evening, then decreasing 3 or 4 by tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight by tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with occasional showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in any showers tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, veering west or northwest 2 to 4 for a time, occasionally increasing 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then outbreaks of rain slowly spreading from the west in the afternoon, becoming mostly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
